notes.title: This Time for Real: Achievements Fixed! 3
notes.notes:
After an epic quest through DLLs, builds, and a suspiciously named “debug” file, achievements are finally behaving.
Just launch the game through Steam and enjoy your well-earned unlocks.
If it doesn’t work... restart and pretend it’s part of the lore!

notes.title: Achievements Achieved! Now It Works!
notes.notes:
Achievements were shy... only showing up in debug mode!
But now, with a little push and lots of coffee, they’re finally working for everyone.
Update the game, launch it through Steam, and watch those glorious pop-ups light up your screen!

notes.title: 🐱✨ Now with 73% fewer bugs (and 100% more achievements!)
notes.notes:
Another round of improvements has arrived to make your feline adventure even smoother! Here's what's new:

    Removed that confusing line in the final environment that no one understood (not even us).

    The cat can no longer try to go full Sonic mid-jump — animations are now ground-exclusive!

    And the best part: Steam achievements are now live! Time to hunt them down like a laser dot on the wall.

Enjoy the new version and keep on jumping (responsibly)! 🐾

notes.title: Height counter fix
notes.notes: Fixed the bug that prevented the height counter from updating or resetting properly.

notes.title: Added timer and solved some problems
notes.notes:
🆕 New Features:

    Added an on-screen timer to track gameplay time.

🐛 Fixes:

    Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would disappear in the main menu.

    Adjusted the screen UI so that information no longer moves with the character.

Thank you for your feedback! We're continuously improving the game! 🚀🎮

notes.title: Finally, a Menu
notes.notes:
1 - New Cute Animations for the Cat!
Now, by pressing the L key on the keyboard or the X button on the Xbox controller, the cat will perform one of 4 cute animations! (Perfect for adorable moments during the game.)

2 - Main Menu Added!
We've added a main menu so you can easily start the game or exit (close the game). Navigation is now more intuitive right from the start!

3 - Changes to the Pause Menu:
The pause menu now includes an option to go directly back to the main screen, making it easier to return to the main menu without exiting the game.

notes.title: Little improves
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Pause Menu: You can now pause the game at any time with a new pause menu that offers convenient options to resume or quit the game.
[*] Height Visualization: We’ve added a clear display of the height you’ve reached in the game, so you can track your progress as you climb.
[*] Bug Fix: We’ve fixed an issue where the character could enter through walls, ensuring a smoother and uninterrupted gameplay experience.
[/list]
